description: UI component library: all shadcn/ui primitive components (button, card, input, etc.) plus layout components (Navbar, Sidebar) and reusable dashboard/analysis components. Depends on FEAT-001 (globals.css, utils, types). Independent of FEAT-002 (can be built in parallel conceptually but executed after it).
steps: Step 1 — Create components/ui/button.tsx. Follow shadcn/ui new-york style. Use cva for variants (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link) and sizes (default, sm, lg, icon). Import cn from @/lib/utils. Use Radix Slot for asChild prop. Dark theme compatible via CSS variables. Add 'use client'. Files: components/ui/button.tsx

Step 2 — Create components/ui/card.tsx. Components: Card (div with rounded-lg border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm), CardHeader, CardContent, CardFooter, CardTitle, CardDescription. No 'use client' needed (pure presentational). Files: components/ui/card.tsx

Step 3 — Create components/ui/input.tsx. Styled input element with flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1. Focus ring using ring CSS variables. Files: components/ui/input.tsx
Step 4 — Create components/ui/label.tsx. Wraps @radix-ui/react-label with text-sm font-medium leading-none peer-disabled:cursor-not-allowed. Files: components/ui/label.tsx
Step 5 — Create components/ui/badge.tsx. Use cva for variants (default, secondary, destructive, outline). Small rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold. Files: components/ui/badge.tsx
Step 6 — Create components/ui/progress.tsx. Wraps @radix-ui/react-progress. Shows a color-coded bar. Accept className and indicatorClassName props. Files: components/ui/progress.tsx

Step 7 — Create components/ui/tabs.tsx. Wraps @radix-ui/react-tabs. Export Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent. Style triggers with data-[state=active] indicator. 'use client'. Files: components/ui/tabs.tsx

Step 8 — Create components/ui/dialog.tsx. Wraps @radix-ui/react-dialog. Export Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent (with overlay + close button), DialogHeader, DialogFooter, DialogTitle, DialogDescription. 'use client'. Files: components/ui/dialog.tsx

Step 9 — Create components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx. Wraps @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu. Export DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator. 'use client'. Files: components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx

Step 10 — Create components/ui/select.tsx. Wraps @radix-ui/react-select. Export Select, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectValue, SelectGroup, SelectLabel. 'use client'. Files: components/ui/select.tsx
Step 11 — Create components/ui/textarea.tsx. Styled textarea with min-h-[60px] w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-2. Files: components/ui/textarea.tsx
Step 12 — Create components/ui/separator.tsx. Wraps @radix-ui/react-separator. Horizontal or vertical. Files: components/ui/separator.tsx
Step 13 — Create components/ui/scroll-area.tsx. Wraps @radix-ui/react-scroll-area. Export ScrollArea, ScrollBar. Files: components/ui/scroll-area.tsx
Step 14 — Create components/ui/avatar.tsx. Wraps @radix-ui/react-avatar. Export Avatar, AvatarImage, AvatarFallback. Files: components/ui/avatar.tsx
Step 15 — Create components/ui/tooltip.tsx. Wraps @radix-ui/react-tooltip. Export Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider. 'use client'. Files: components/ui/tooltip.tsx

Step 16 — Create components/ui/accordion.tsx. Wraps @radix-ui/react-accordion. Export Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent. Uses ChevronDown icon from lucide-react. 'use client'. Files: components/ui/accordion.tsx

Step 17 — Create components/layout/Navbar.tsx. 'use client'. Shows logo (graduation cap icon + 'AI Resume Analyzer'), navigation links (Dashboard, Resume, Analyze, Skills, Resources, Roadmap, Progress), user avatar dropdown (Profile, Settings, Logout). Uses useAuth hook. Responsive: hamburger menu on mobile. Dark navy bg matching --background. Files: components/layout/Navbar.tsx

Step 18 — Create components/layout/Sidebar.tsx. 'use client'. Left sidebar for dashboard layout. Icons + labels for each nav item. Active state highlighted. Uses usePathname from next/navigation. Collapsible on mobile. Files: components/layout/Sidebar.tsx

Step 19 — Create components/common/LoadingState.tsx. 'use client'. Shows animated analysis progress with step messages: ['Parsing resume...', 'Extracting skills...', 'Running ATS checks...', 'Matching job requirements...', 'Generating recommendations...', 'Building your report...']. Uses framer-motion for step transitions. Files: components/common/LoadingState.tsx
Step 20 — Create components/common/EmptyState.tsx. Generic empty state with icon, title, description, optional action button. Files: components/common/EmptyState.tsx

Step 21 — Create components/dashboard/StatsCard.tsx. Card showing a metric with icon, value, label, and optional trend indicator. Accepts color prop for the icon/value. Files: components/dashboard/StatsCard.tsx

Step 22 — Create components/dashboard/ScoreRing.tsx. 'use client'. SVG circular progress ring. Props: score (0-100), size, strokeWidth, label. Color: <50 red, 50-70 amber, >70 green. Animated fill on mount using framer-motion. Shows score number in center. Files: components/dashboard/ScoreRing.tsx
Step 23 — Create components/dashboard/SkillBar.tsx. Visual bar showing skill name, current match percentage vs required. Gap portion highlighted in amber/red. Files: components/dashboard/SkillBar.tsx

Step 24 — Create components/dashboard/RecentAnalysis.tsx. Table/card list of recent analyses. Each row: resume name, target role, score badge, date, 'View Report' button linking to /analysis/[id]. Files: components/dashboard/RecentAnalysis.tsx

Step 25 — Create components/dashboard/SkillGapCard.tsx. Card showing a single skill gap: skill name, importance badge (critical=red, high=amber, medium=blue), why it matters, what to do. Files: components/dashboard/SkillGapCard.tsx
Step 26 — Create components/dashboard/RecommendedActions.tsx. Numbered list of action items. Each item: number circle, action text, optional link. Files: components/dashboard/RecommendedActions.tsx

Step 27 — Create components/dashboard/ProgressChart.tsx. 'use client'. Uses recharts LineChart to show score history over time. Axes, tooltip, responsive container. Files: components/dashboard/ProgressChart.tsx

Step 28 — Create components/resume/ResumeUpload.tsx. 'use client'. HTML5 drag-and-drop zone + click-to-browse. Accepts PDF/DOCX/TXT, max 5MB. Shows file name after selection. Upload button. Progress indicator during upload. onUpload callback. Files: components/resume/ResumeUpload.tsx

Step 29 — Create components/resume/ResumePreview.tsx. 'use client'. Displays extracted ResumeData in a structured preview: name/contact header, then sections (Summary, Skills chips, Experience cards, Education, Projects, Certifications). Files: components/resume/ResumePreview.tsx

Step 30 — Create components/resume/ResumeEditor.tsx. 'use client'. Inline editing for each section of ResumeData. Uses react-hook-form. Renders current data with Edit button per section. In edit mode, shows form fields. Save triggers onSave(updatedData) callback. Files: components/resume/ResumeEditor.tsx

Step 31 — Create components/analysis/OverallScore.tsx. 'use client'. Shows ScoreRing for overall score + four dimension scores (ATS, Job Match, Skills, Content) as horizontal bars with labels. Files: components/analysis/OverallScore.tsx

Step 32 — Create components/analysis/ATSAnalysis.tsx. Renders list of ATSCheck items. Pass = green checkmark, fail = red X. Grouped by category. Shows actionable suggestion for failed checks. Files: components/analysis/ATSAnalysis.tsx

Step 33 — Create components/analysis/SkillGapAnalysis.tsx. 'use client'. Full skill analysis: left side shows all role skills with present/absent badges, right side shows gap list with SkillGapCard components. Files: components/analysis/SkillGapAnalysis.tsx

Step 34 — Create components/analysis/ContentAnalysis.tsx. Renders ContentSuggestion list. Each item shows: section label, priority badge, 'Current' text in amber box, 'Suggested' text in green box with arrow between them, and reason. Files: components/analysis/ContentAnalysis.tsx

Step 35 — Create components/analysis/ImprovementSuggestions.tsx. Prioritized improvement list. Groups by priority (high/medium/low). Each suggestion has priority badge, current vs suggested diff view, copy button. Files: components/analysis/ImprovementSuggestions.tsx

Step 36 — Create components/resources/ResourceCard.tsx. Card for a Resource: title, provider, type badge, free/paid badge, difficulty badge, duration, link button. Files: components/resources/ResourceCard.tsx

Step 37 — Create components/resources/ProjectRecommendation.tsx. Card for ProjectRecommendation: title, description, tech stack chips, estimated time, resume impact text, 'Add to Plan' button. Files: components/resources/ProjectRecommendation.tsx

Step 38 — Create components/roadmap/RoadmapStep.tsx. Visual step in a roadmap timeline: step number circle, stage name, skills/tasks list, estimated timeline. Connected by vertical line to next step. Files: components/roadmap/RoadmapStep.tsx
acceptance_criteria: All components compile with zero TypeScript errors
Each component file starts with 'use client' only when it uses hooks, event handlers, or browser APIs
All Radix UI imports match the installed package versions
ScoreRing renders a correct SVG circle with score-based color coding
npm run build passes with zero errors after this FEAT
verification: cd C:/Users/kolte/AIresume/AI_ResumeAnalyzer && npm run build -- must complete with no TypeScript errors across all component files
findings: 1) recharts v3 TooltipProps does not expose 'active', 'payload', or 'label' as named props via the generic TooltipProps<number,string> import — the custom tooltip component must use a hand-typed interface with those props. 2) All 38 components compile cleanly with zero TypeScript errors. 3) 'use client' applied only to components that use hooks, event handlers, or browser APIs (useState, useEffect, usePathname, framer-motion, clipboard API). 4) Card, badge, and presentational components are Server Components with no 'use client'. 5) ScoreRing uses SVG + framer-motion for animated circular progress with score-based color coding (red <50, amber 50-70, green >70). 6) ResumeEditor uses react-hook-form with zod validation for the basic info section; experience bullets are edited with local state. 7) npm run build passes with exit code 0.
